## Summary
- Introduce `emitAction` + `ACTIONS_CATALOG` so each product action emits a correlated log, metric(s), and child span under the HTTP `trace_id`.
- Expand the metrics catalog (auth failures, illegal moves, match/bot duration, active matches, lobby/scoreboard views, admin injects, export errors) and fix `arcade_http_duration_ms` as a histogram.
- Admin portal gains an **actions** tab and `POST /api/admin/actions/inject` for full triad injection; strategy documented in `docs/observability-strategy.md`.

## Test plan
- [x] `bunx tsc --noEmit` in `apps/web`
- [x] Live API: admin metrics returns 16 metrics + 17 actions; illegal move rejected; action inject of `match.move` ×2 succeeded
- [ ] Admin UI: open Actions tab, inject an action, confirm OpenObserve logs/metrics/traces
- [ ] Play a short match and confirm nested spans share `x-trace-id`


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
title: Correlate every action across logs, metrics, and traces
